decision.adoption: NOT_ADOPTED: no independent later-season evaluation exists; 2021 is the candidate-selection fold and 2022 was exposed in Phase 2A.
decision.summary: Best 2021 development candidate by goal CRPS is C v2 goal prior: paired goal-CRPS gain +0.0529 [+0.0357, +0.0697] and final-energy gain +0.0799 [+0.0530, +0.1056] versus matched Phase 2A. It also worsens team SOG CRPS on this fold. These intervals are descriptive after candidate selection, so this remains a research result, not adoption evidence.

development.seed_formula: seed + game_index * 1000003 + trial; same seed set for all V3 candidates and matched references

v2_goal_prior_offsets.offset: log(v2 pregame expected goals / Phase 2A pregame simulated goal mean)

selection_population: 2021 forward development; V3 and v2 fit only on 2018-2020
